description: Optimistic store mutates record data before validating expected version, corrupting shared data when conflicts occur.
spec_notes: OptimisticStore.update must verify curr.version == expected_version prior to applying data mutations.

"""Entity record with version identifier."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict


@dataclass
class VersionedRecord:
    record_id: str
    data: Dict[str, Any]
    version: int

tests.test_optimistic_locking.py:
from storage import OptimisticStore
from session import DocumentSession


def test_sequential_updates():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    store.insert("doc_1", {"title": "Draft", "views": 0})
    s1 = DocumentSession(store)
    res1 = s1.patch_document("doc_1", {"title": "Published"})
    assert res1 is True
    rec = store.get("doc_1")
    assert rec.version == 2
    assert rec.data["title"] == "Published"


def test_concurrent_conflict_rejected_without_corrupting_data():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    store.insert("doc_2", {"balance": 100})
    # Worker 1 and Worker 2 both read version 1
    s1 = DocumentSession(store)
    s2 = DocumentSession(store)
    rec1 = store.get("doc_2")
    rec2 = store.get("doc_2")
    assert rec1.version == 1 and rec2.version == 1

    # Worker 1 commits update to balance 150 (version becomes 2)
    assert store.update("doc_2", {"balance": 150}, expected_version=1) is True
    assert store.get("doc_2").version == 2

    # Worker 2 tries to commit stale update to balance 200 using expected_version=1
    assert store.update("doc_2", {"balance": 200}, expected_version=1) is False
    # CRITICAL: Document data MUST retain Worker 1 update (150), NOT be corrupted with 200!
    assert store.get("doc_2").data["balance"] == 150
    assert store.get("doc_2").version == 2


def test_update_missing_record():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    assert store.update("missing", {"k": 1}, 1) is False


def test_version_increments_monotonically():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    store.insert("d", {"v": 0})
    for i in range(1, 6):
        assert store.update("d", {"v": i}, expected_version=i) is True
    assert store.get("d").version == 6
    assert store.get("d").data["v"] == 5


def test_patch_document_missing():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    s = DocumentSession(store)
    assert s.patch_document("ghost", {"a": 1}) is False


def test_record_snapshot_immutability():
    store = OptimisticStore()
    store.insert("d1", {"meta": "original"})
    snap = store.get("d1")
    snap.data["meta"] = "tampered"
    assert store.get("d1").data["meta"] == "original"
